data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'Juda', meaning 'to give'. In Islamic tradition, Joudah symbolizes generosity, kindness, and the giving of blessings. The name Joudah carries the meaning “Gift” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Joudah usually hope their child will grow to embody gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name with deep spiritual significance, reflecting the idea of giving and receiving blessings in Islam.
data.etymology: Joudah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Joudah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: جودة
in_arabic.long_meaning: معنى أسمي 'جودة' في اللغة العربية هو 'إبلاغة عن' أو 'البلاغ'. هذا الاسم يعني 'الذي يبلغ' أو 'الذي يبلغ بالكامل'.

in_urdu.name: جودہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: اسم 'جودہ' بهاس پاکستانی شبکہ اندرجی میں 'جلبنا' ہوتا ہے. یہ اسم کو جلوانی کے ساتھ مانا جاتا ہے، جس سے ان میں بہترین وجه دیتا ہواتا ہے.

in_hindi.name: जूदह
in_hindi.long_meaning: अरبी साزISH 'जودة' का मतलब है 'समझना' या 'समझानेवाला'। यह संदेश के लिए दिया गया है जो समझने वाला है।

in_pashto.name: جوده
in_pashto.long_meaning: پشتونون دیل کے مادہ میں 'جوده' کا معنی 'خبر دادنا' ہے। یہ اسم کو بہترین طریقہ سے خبر کے باوجود دینا کے معنی سے مانا جاتا ہے.

It is thought that individuals with the name Joudah possess a naturally generous and kind disposition, making them valued members of their communities.

Furthermore, it serves as an inspiration to regularly give back to others, as even small acts of kindness can bring significant blessings.
